title: Canvas interaction performance and larger mesh support
summary: Improved interconnect-canvas rendering and event handling through concrete frontend optimizations.

dates.note: Individual implementation dates are not established; the supplied engineering analysis is an October 5, 2026 snapshot.

facts.text: Introduced Pixi.js to improve newer NoC canvas performance.
Optimized canvas interactions through cached DOM geometry, frame-batched pointer/pan updates, processing outside Angular change detection and shared zoom/pan behavior.
Improved event/subscription cleanup and resolved ResizeObserver-related memory leaks.
Extended GUI coordinate and identifier handling to support 64×64 coherent meshes.

notes: No defensible measured speedup, memory-reduction percentage, or before/after timing is supplied.
